parametrized_description: A store owner spends at most MaxExpenditure per month on carrots and cucumbers. Carrots cost CostCarrot each and cucumbers cost CostCucumber each. Profit is ProfitCarrot per carrot and ProfitCucumber per cucumber. Cucumbers sold is at most CucumberFraction of carrots sold. Between MinCarrots and MaxCarrots carrots are sold per month. Maximize profit.

MaxExpenditure.description: Maximum monthly expenditure on carrots and cucumbers

CucumberFraction.description: Maximum ratio of cucumbers sold to carrots sold

MinCarrots.description: Minimum number of carrots sold per month

MaxCarrots.description: Maximum number of carrots sold per month

NumCarrots.description: Number of carrots to sell per month

NumCucumbers.description: Number of cucumbers to sell per month

constraints.description: Total expenditure must not exceed MaxExpenditure.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(CostCarrot * NumCarrots + CostCucumber * NumCucumbers <= MaxExpenditure, name="Budget")

constraints.description: Cucumbers sold must be at most CucumberFraction times carrots sold.
At least MinCarrots carrots must be sold.
At most MaxCarrots carrots can be sold.
Number of cucumbers must be non-negative.

objective.description: Maximize total profit from carrots and cucumbers.
